subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 1: Reading – the importance of languages
outcomes: Read short and long texts and choose answers that match all the information.
Find the main idea and the writer's opinion in an article.
Understand why languages are important to culture and identity.

tf.s: Arabic is spoken by more than 300 million people.
tf.why: This is one of the true facts in the language quiz.

tf.s: In multiple choice, the right option often uses synonyms of words in the text.
tf.why: Finding synonyms helps you match the text and the option.

tf.s: The notice says only students with good grades can attend the extra English lessons.
tf.why: Students with low grades can attend too.

tf.s: Eliza sent Anna a message about paying for the trip.
tf.why: The trip money is due on Friday.

tf.s: When he was young, the writer loved learning French.
tf.why: He was unhappy because it didn't seem necessary.

tf.s: The writer wants to keep as many languages alive as possible.
tf.why: He says languages carry stories, traditions and memories.

tf.s: Léa thinks learning a new language is a negative experience.
tf.why: Léa is positive: she says it's a wonderful experience.

tf.s: Léa's cousins helped her learn the most Wolof.
tf.why: Her cousins were her age and were learning French.

tf.s: 'The three weeks flew by' means the weeks went very quickly.

boxes.why: A language at risk might die out.

boxes.q: Where might you see an 'Extra English lessons' text?
Why did Eliza send the message?
o: to tell Anna to pay for the trip
to invite Anna to a party
boxes.why: The trip money is due on Friday.

boxes.q: Complete: Something strange ___ over the weekend.
Complete: The grammar lesson was ___ confusing at first.
What did the writer learn when he returned to Canada?
o: Some classmates spoke French at home
boxes.why: French was the first language of some classmates.

boxes.q: What does Fatma need her dad to do?
o: deliver her Chinese notes to school
boxes.why: She asks him to take her notes to the school reception.

boxes.q: Which word means 'still living or existing'?
boxes.why: Languages that are still used are alive.

boxes.q: What happens when a language 'dies out'?
boxes.why: A language dies out when it stops being used.

boxes.q: What is the opinion of the writer of 'The importance of languages'?
o: We should stop languages dying out
boxes.why: He believes languages connect us to history and culture.

mcq.q: Which languages does the article mention in Canada?
o: English, French, Cree, Ojibwe and Inuktitut
mcq.why: Skimming the article shows these languages.

mcq.q: How did the writer feel about learning French when he was young?
o: Unhappy, because it didn't seem necessary
Bored, because it was too easy
mcq.why: He didn't see why he needed French.

mcq.q: What kind of texts are the 'Extra English lessons' text and Eliza's text?
o: a school notice and a phone message
mcq.why: Knowing the text type helps you understand its purpose.
The original form is the first one.

mcq.q: Complete: 'Some languages are ___, and they might die out soon.'
mcq.why: Languages in danger are at risk.

mcq.q: A notice says 'Contact your teacher.' Which option means the same?
o: Send an email to the head
mcq.why: 'Contact your teacher' and 'speak to their teacher' mean the same.

mcq.q: Which is a good reason against 'The world only needs one language'?
o: Different languages keep cultures and traditions alive
One language is cheaper to print
Everyone already speaks the same language
mcq.why: Languages carry culture, stories and history.

mcq.q: Why is answer A correct for the writer's main point?
o: He says languages carry stories, traditions and memories, so he wants to keep them alive
He says French is the only important language
He says learning languages is a waste of time
He says all languages are the same
mcq.why: The main point comes from the whole text, not one detail.

mcq.q: What would Léa say to someone thinking about learning a new language?
o: If you ever get the chance, do it – it's wonderful
Don't do it, it's too hard
mcq.why: Léa's blog is very positive about learning Wolof.

mcq.q: Why is option A wrong for the 'Extra English lessons' question?
o: The notice says students with low grades can attend too
The notice says there are no lessons
The notice is about a sports club
mcq.why: The right option must match all the information in the text.
